nodes.text: Oh hiya dearie, are you stocking up too?
Yes dearie, my you can be so forgetful

dialogueChoices.text: Oh, right...So what are you doing here?

nodes.text: I'm stocking up for making my famous granola bars

dialogueChoices.text: Well, I hope that goes well for you

nodes.text: Of course. With everyone in a tissy over the disaster coming they need something easy to eat

dialogueChoices.text: Do you really plan to make granola bars for everyone in town?
Sounds like hard work, count me out

nodes.text: Oh it's really no trouble, I'll make sure everyone gets what they need

dialogueChoices.text: Do you have everything you need then?
Well, I hope you get them made
You really should take care of yourself too, Janet

nodes.text: I'm missing flour, but the store is all out. Without flour, I can't make the granola bars

dialogueChoices.text: I can bring you some flour by tomorrow
Damn, that sucks, I need to go now

nodes.text: oh, alright. Goodbye dearie, and stay safe
Oh, and here I thought you were the kind type
Oh, you're too kind dearie, don't you fret about me now

dialogueChoices.text: Okay Janet, do you at least have everything you need?

nodes.text: Oh thank you so much dearie, if it's not too much trouble that is.

dialogueChoices.text: Goodbye Janet, Stay safe out there

nodes.text: Oh thank you, and you stay safe too!
